d: As an Advanced Field Service Engineer here at Honeywell, you will have the opportunity to provide advanced technical facilitation and expertise to our customers in the Process Automation (PA) business unit. You will be accountable for troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues, ensuring the successful implementation of our solutions, and driving customer satisfaction. Your expertise and dedication to excellence will play a crucial role in the success of our field service operations and the growth of our business. You will report directly to our Field Service Engineering Manager, and you'll work out of our Kuwait location on a hybrid work schedule.
In this role, you will impact the efficiency, productivity, and safety of our customers' operations by providing exceptional technical facilitation and service.
q: Hands-on experience of EPKS Server and Station Maintenance - 10 years with 8 + years’ experience as senior FSE (service and maintenance).
Hands-on experience of EPKS C300 controller troubleshooting, maintenance, and service engineer - 8 years
Hands-on experience of Managing sites with FIM, Fieldbus, Thin Clients
Hands-on experience of Thin Client configuration, troubleshooting
Hardware troubleshooting for ICSS components like C300, IO modules, FIMS
GTAC data collection procedure, guidelines, GTAC audit checks
Hands-on experience with hardware replacements and fault finding
Honeywell EPKS software re-installation, patch updates, MS-ISO updates, AV update
Additions, modifications etc. in Hardware & Software Configurations
implementing changes as per GTAC guidelines
Clear with 3rd party integration protocols and communication protocols
Minimum certification EPKS L4 & OPM L3.
Experience of carrying out OPM, Patch updates, Controller and IOP firmware upgrades on an online system
Engineers with Oil and Gas / Petrochemical / Refinery industry experience.
Must have experience to work on Honeywell Safety Manager
Experience on working under pressure and know how to respond in emergencies
Knowledge of networking components like switches, routers and firewall
Knowledge of Peripheral Honeywell systems like Dynamo, APC
Engineer (Project environment) with commissioning and SAT experience
CCNI and Cybersecurity certification is a distinct advantage

x: Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

d: Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in MENA. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai Company is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in the MENA region and the market leader in all its categories across GCC, Egypt, and Jordan.
Over five decades of sustainable growth, Almarai has consistently provided nutritious and healthy products to consumers of all ages, driven by its core principle: “Quality you can trust.”

Almarai has expanded its product range to include, in addition to dairy products, juices and beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water, under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L’usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, Farm’s Select, Ice Leaf, Almira, Seama, Oska, IVAL, Almara Pro, Premier Chef, Bakemart, and others. Almarai currently employs over 43,000 Quality Makers, across the GCC, Egypt & Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported net income of SAR 2.4 billion on sales of SAR 22 billion.

To deliver the targeted volume & margin of all Almarai product range in his route by achieving the right product distribution with wastages within budgeted level & ensuring good customer service adhering strictly to company’s trade, quality & safety policies.
